name: What is the typical warranty period for custom kitchen cabinetry?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical warranty period for custom kitchen cabinetry?

acceptedAnswer.text: The warranty period for custom kitchen cabinetry can vary depending on the manufacturer of the materials and the craftsmanship of the installer. Typically, structural components and hardware may carry warranties ranging from 5 years to a lifetime against defects. It's important to clarify the specifics of both material warranties from suppliers and our installation workmanship guarantee during the proposal stage. Reviewing these details ensures you understand the coverage for your investment and can address any potential issues post-installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Warranty periods for custom kitchen cabinetry typically range from 5 years to a lifetime for structural components and hardware, depending on materials and craftsmanship.
